{{Top|Enemy|Bosses#Assassins|Assassins|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Dread is the calling card of the Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.}} '''Dread''' is a deadly hunting bow that fires bladed arrows, serving as the [[Stalker]]'s signature weapon. This bow sports a large amount of {{D|Slash}} damage, the highest [[critical chance]] stat matched only by the {{Weapon|Lenz}} and [[Kuva Chakkhurr]], and high [[status chance]], causing many shots to inflict {{D|Slash}} procs. This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage. *Can use the Dread-exclusive {{M|Unseen Dread}} mod. {{Advantages|class=Bow|}} {{Disadvantages|class=Bow|}} {{Acquisition|Dread's blueprint is dropped by the [[Stalker]]. It is also included in the [[What Stalker?]] bundle for {{pc|725}} in the market.}} {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *Dread has a hidden mechanic similar to [[Sniper combo|Sniper Combo]] which is not mentioned in game: After landing '''2''' consecutive hits (including from multishot and punch through) on enemies within '''5''' seconds, all subsequent shots will deal '''2x''' total damage. After '''90''' consecutive hits, this is increased to '''3x''' total damage, which is the cap. This effect resets upon missing every arrow (from multishot) in a single shot, or waiting more than '''5''' seconds between shots. **The Incarnon mode does '''not''' interact with the combo mechanic whatsoever. It does not benefit from the damage multiplier, and the current combo count will be frozen until switching back to the normal firing mode; hitting enemies will not increase the combo count, and missing shots or waiting more than 5 seconds between shots will not reset the current combo count. *All "charge weapons" (guns) are capable of holding their charge during a [[Maneuvers#Sprinting|sprint]]. As long as the user starts the charge, they are able to finish the charge while they are still sprinting. This grants more mobility for the user. An example of this is charging the weapon from behind cover, then running into a room and firing the bow as soon as an enemy is sighted. **Using elevators and opening co-op doors does not cancel the charge; however, hacking consoles and opening lockers will. **[[Maneuvers#Sliding|Sliding]] when you are about to hit the ground (from any height) is very useful for keeping your charge instead of losing it by [[Maneuvers#Rolling|rolling]].  **While [[Maneuvers#Wall Running|wall running]] will not cancel the charge, [[Maneuvers#Edge Grab|edge grabbing]] will. *A maxed out {{M|Point Strike}} increases the Dread's [[critical chance]] to 125%, guaranteeing normal crits and a 25% chance to proc orange crits, approximately doubling the critical damage. *In [[Conclave]], Dread will apply a 2-second {{D|Slash}} proc to the target, each damage tick dealing 3 to 5 damage, depending on the level of charge when fired. Note that this passive isn't consistent, and can occur on near misses to targets as well as direct hits. == Incarnon Genesis == {{Transclude|Dread Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}} {{Transclude|Dread Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}} ==Tips== *{{M|Hunter Munitions}} excels on this weapon thanks to its very high [[critical chance]]. It's of questionable value, though, since the weapon will already consistently proc {{D|Slash}} with a high status build. **The weapon's high [[status chance]] allows {{D|Viral}} procs via {{M|Rime Rounds}} and {{M|Malignant Force}} to further complement the {{D|Slash}} procs, although since the status changes of [[Update 27#Update_27.2|Update 27.2]] Viral will be weighted more heavily than Slash in terms of status effect priority, necessitating reliance on Hunter Munitions taking effect. *Fire rate increases charge rate, so {{M|Speed Trigger}} helps immensely. Alternatives are {{M|Shred}} ({{M|Primed Shred}}) or {{M|Vile Acceleration}}, as they will all allow you to charge your bow rapidly. *Dread can stagger [[Infested|Ancients]] on every hit, even with uncharged shots, this is quite helpful on long Infested/Void missions, where high level Ancients become a challenge to deal with. *{{M|Thunderbolt}} and [[Multishot]] can add a devastating (albeit weaker against higher-level enemies) AoE effect for fighting multiple targets. ==Trivia== *The Dread is unique in that its 'string' glows. Light runs along the string towards the draw point. **This light glows reddish when it is drawn. *Unlike the other bows, the Dread, utilizing primarily {{D|Slash}} damage, uses arrows with a curved blade for a tip, as opposed to the pointed head of {{D|Puncture}}-based {{Weapon|Paris}} ([[Paris Prime|Prime]]), or the blunted mace-like head of the {{D|Impact}}-based {{Weapon|Cernos}} ([[Cernos Prime|Prime]]). **When drawing the bow, the arrow's blade rotates from a horizontal to a vertical position, meaning that fully charged shots are fired with their blades vertically. This clashes with the [[Codex]] description, which describes decapitating arrows, as a horizontal blade is better suited to decapitation. *The Dread has a cylindrical object installed near the grip. While its purpose is unknown, it is possibly a laser sight, rangefinder, or other form of optical assist. *Despite the Dread being referred to as the ''Stalker's'' calling card, it is strangely available for purchase with [[Darvo]]'s rotating stock. It is never explained where he obtained this stock of the Stalker's weapons nor where the Dread, {{Weapon|Despair}} and {{Weapon|Hate}} are produced. *The Dread's arms don't move when an arrow is pulled back; only the string does. ==Media== dread visual.jpg|Dread in the Codex. Dread Arsenal.png|Dread as shown in the Arsenal Dread Arsenal 2.png Dread Arrow Quiver.png|Dread's Arrow Quiver {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|BwxGSg-eRvQ|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|4LB7JEi9UEM|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|yBIW3HciJDY|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|KuDgXwa73Yc|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|44.0}} *Reduced the draw SFX on Dread following community feedback. {{ver|43.0.4}} *Fixed the Dread missing weapon stats in the Arsenal if installed with an Incarnon Genesis. {{ver|36}} *Increased (Shadow) Stalker’s drop rate for Despair, Scimitar Engines Blueprint, Hate, War, and Broken War to 11.73% each. **Dread’s drop chance has been reduced on both Stalker (64.8%) and Shadow Stalker (41.33%) to compensate. **Note: The Drop Chance of rolling a reward from this Drop Table is unchanged (i.e. 50%). *Updated the visual materials on the Dread. **This change also made many untintable areas now tintable (notably all of the metal on the Dread). {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Dread {{ver|25.7}} *Normalized quick shots to have the same critical chance/damage and status chance as charged shots. *While reviewing Bow stats the team has also refreshed all their FX (including the Lenz)! *Quick Shot increased from 130 to 168 *Charged Shot increased from 200 to 336 {{ver|25.0.7}} *Fixed the Dread Energy color persisting as default on the strings. {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 0 to 5. *Charge speed decreased from 1 to 0.5 seconds. {{ver|8}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|23.10.4}} ==See also== *[[Stalker]], the assassin that uses this weapon. *[[Hunhow's Gift]], a pack of items used by the [[Shadow Stalker]]. *[[Dread Incarnon Genesis]], the Incarnon power-up for the Dread. {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Dread]] [[es:Dread]] [[fr:Dread]] [[Category:Update 8]] [[Category:Stalker]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Slash Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Bow]] [[Category:Silent]] [[Category:Single-Shot]] [[Category:Augmented Weapons]] [[uk:Жах]]

{{RequisiteWeapon|Ingredient For = {{Weapon|Zarr}}}} {{Top|Enemy|Grineer|Grineer|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|The Drakgoon Flak Cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.}} The '''Drakgoon '''is a [[Grineer]] flak cannon with a distinct charge mechanic. The longer the weapon is charged, the tighter the spread of the pellets fired, and charged shots gain [[punch through]] depending on how long the charge is held, giving the Drakgoon extreme versatility at any range. Additionally, the flak from the Drakgoon can bounce off surfaces once, allowing for a volley to hit more than once if positioned correctly. This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}; it is also a [[weapon crafting ingredient]] for the {{Weapon|Zarr}}. {{Checklist|nocategory=true| * {{Weapon|Drakgoon}} → {{Weapon|Zarr}} }} ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage. *Shots [[ricochet]] once. **This allows one to fire at a wall and kill an enemy behind cover, albeit with some difficulty. *Charged shots have innate 2 meter [[punch through]]. *Innate [[multishot]] of 10 pellets. *Effective over multiple ranges due to charge/spread mechanic: **Uncharged shots fires wide-dispersal shots to soften up multiple enemies at mid/long range, or quickly hit a single target at short range. **Charged shots fires a tightly focused blast over longer ranges for high single-target damage. *Can use the Drakgoon-exclusive {{M|Fomorian Accelerant}} mod. {{Advantages|class=Shotgun| *High charge speed. *No damage falloff. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun| *Shrapnel projectiles have travel time. **Shrapnel projectiles slow down by a great margin after ricocheting. **Shrapnel will vanish after 2 seconds of leaving the weapon. }} {{WeaponComparison|Kuva Drakgoon}} ==Acquisition== The Drakgoon's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]]. Alternatively, it can be acquired from completing the [[Neptune]] to [[Pluto]] [[Junction]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== *The projectiles bounce once when not charged, and bounce twice when fully charged.  *The "Flak" from the weapon works with {{WF|Mag}}'s {{A|Magnetize}} and can headshot if it enters the field at a high enough point. ==Tips== *Shrapnel spread upon fire will narrow as the charge is held. Using {{M|Accelerated Blast}} and {{M|Shotgun Barrage}} will decrease the charge time, whilst accuracy mods like {{M|Tainted Shell}} will reduce the initial uncharged spread. *Rolling will cancel the charge. *If a melee attack is performed while holding down the charge, it will fire and then immediately melee. *The charge can be held while sprinting, sliding, wall running, and wall clinging, allowing for mobility and closing in on enemy targets. *The Drakgoon excels against the Infested thanks to its Slash-focused damage. There are a few ways to increase its effectiveness; **Use ({{M|Primed Point Blank|Primed}}) {{M|Point Blank}} for damage and {{M|Cleanse Infested}} for increased effectiveness against Infested enemies. **Use {{M|Shredder}} and/or {{M|Sweeping Serration}} to increase both the {{D|Slash}} damage and its proc chance. **Use {{M|Blaze}} and {{M|Incendiary Coat}} to add {{D|Heat}}. ***When combined with {{D|Toxin}} from {{M|Toxic Barrage}} and {{M|Contagious Spread}}, the resulting {{D|Gas}} element is even more effective against Deimos Infested than {{D|Heat}}. *The pellets will ricochet off the environments only once. If well handled, these pellets can clear a tight, empty room as every pellet has a second opportunity to hit a target if they missed the first time. *Firing an uncharged shot at a low angle into the ground will cause the ricocheted projectiles to form into a horizontal line with significantly lower spread. This is useful for quickly taking out groups of charging infested at medium range without having to charge. *Equipping {{M|Tainted Shell}} makes this weapon an extremely accurate long-distance weapon when fully charged. *{{M|Fatal Acceleration}} is extremely useful for increasing the Drakgoon's effectiveness at long range; at maximum rank, the Drakgoon's shrapnel will have a speed slightly higher than the shots of a {{Weapon|Dera}}. ==Bugs== *The Drakgoon's charging animation is not affected by mods. This, however, is purely visual. *[[Punch through]] is currently bugged and acts unpredictably, at best.  ==Trivia== *Concept art of it was first seen in [[Livestream 17]], and this weapon would be introduced on January 8, 2014. *"''Drakgoon''" may be a combination of ''Flak'' and ''Dragoon''. **''[[wikipedia:Anti-aircraft warfare|Flak]]'' is derived from the German '''Fl'''ieger'''a'''bwehr'''k'''anone (literally "air defense cannon"). This is any cannon used primarily for anti aircraft fire, but the term is often used to refer to an anti aircraft cannon that fires a shell that bursts in the air, sending a spray of shrapnel towards the target: the idea being that a spread of shrapnel will have a greater chance of hitting a moving target by covering a large area, as opposed to a single shell, which can only cover its impact point. **''[[wikipedia:Dragoon|Dragoon]]'' refers to mounted infantry trained to deliver tremendous damage against a squad of unmounted infantry, thus relating the weapon's capability of spreading massive damage against a crowd of enemies. They are named as such because they wield a weapon known as the 'dragon', which is essentially a handgun-sized version of the blunderbuss (the forerunner of the modern shotgun). *There is Grineer text on both sides of the Drakgoon with the first line saying {{GrineerScript|FLAK}} "'''FLAK'''". The second line reads {{GrineerScript|1.8}} "'''1.8'''". *This is the first shotgun to gain a Charge feature. *Prior to {{ver|11.6.1}}, the Drakgoon used Rifle Ammunition instead of Shotgun Ammunition. *This is the third shotgun to have a non-static model, following the {{Weapon|Boar Prime}} and the {{Weapon|Sobek}}. *The colored cap on the top of the mid portion of the Drakgoon is what appears to be the magazine. This magazine is awkwardly small if it contains ammunition but the Drakgoon appears to instead use energy projectiles, suggesting this is a battery or an energy capsule. *Starting December 10th, 2020, this weapon, along with the {{Weapon|Ogris}} and {{Weapon|Stahlta}}, had a themed skin which could be obtained for free from the Epic Games [[Unreal Tournament Weapon Bundle]], formerly available on the Epic Games Launcher. **On December 9th, 2024, the skins were made available upon login until December 23rd, 2024, after which the skins were permanently added to the [[Market]] for {{cc|1}}. ==Media== Drakgoon-flack-cannon.png TR Drakgoon.jpg 20161102133520 1.jpg|Rubedo Plated Drakgoon Skin Drakgoon Grineer.jpg Drakgoon Arsenal 1.png|Drakgoon as shown in the arsenal Drakgoon Arsenal 2.png {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|QlFEbJa2dWs|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|mgswtlM063Y|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|3sH05CCYT-8|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|Ew-17mn6Lu8|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|iGWXLUVDm88|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|fXqFDA2ksZI|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|BoT1gPJVbI4|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Drakgoon ;FIXES: *Fixed missing texture on Drakgoon’s default projectiles. {{ver|27.2}} ;Greater than 100% Status having meaning: Shotguns have a unique Role here based on a very patch-work history with how they interact with Status Chance. A Shotgun that shoots 99% Status Chance would give you 35% (roughly) status per pellet. 100% Status Gives you 100% Status per pellet. This huge jump in performance happens with just a 1% gain - why? Well, to answer that we have to look at our choice to make what the UI conveys reality. It would feel broken to shoot a Shotgun with 100% Status and not see a perfect spread of Effects. In reality, to make Status consistent we have to treat Shotguns as a special case. Shotguns as a special case means we have buffed the Status Chance of all Shotguns by x3 or greater. The UI now behaves to show the reality that you are determining Status Chance per pellet. *(Undocumented) Status chance per projectile increased from 2.6% to 6.9%. {{ver|25.7}} *Converted materials to PBR on the Drakgoon {{ver|22.13.1}} *Fixed numerous projectile weapons (Drakgoon, etc) having incorrect Status Chance calculations. {{ver|22.12}} *Mastery Rank increased from 3 to 5. *Quick shot damage increased from 35 to 40 (per pellet). *Status chance increased from 10% to 23% (charged). *Increased Projectile Speed. *Reduced charge time from 1s to 0.5s. *Projectile lifetime reduced from 4s to 2s. *Damage of charged shot decreased from 90 to 70 (per pellet). {{ver|19.0.5}} *Improved performance of a number of projectile weapons including Drakgoon. {{ver|The Index Preview}} *The Drakgoon is now available for use in Conclave. {{ver|18.10}} *Added Drakgoon-exclusive, {{M|Fomorian Accelerant}}. {{ver|18.1}} *Fixed innate punch through not working correctly for the Drakgoon. {{ver|14.0.11}} *Normalized damage multiplier. {{ver|14}} *Improved effect performance. {{ver|12.0.1}} *Fixed status chance for projectile weapons that shot multiple pellets. {{ver|11.6.1}} *Now uses shotgun instead of rifle ammo. *Tweaked Sound effects. *Fixed custom colors not being applied. {{ver|11.6}} *Introduced. }} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Kuva Drakgoon}}, the [[Kuva Lich]] counterpart of this weapon. *{{Weapon|Corvas}}, an [[Archwing]] weapon with similar functionality. *{{Weapon|Zarr}}, a cannon crafted with Drakgoon. {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Drakgoon]] [[es:Drakgoon]] [[fr:Drakgoon]] [[Category:Update 11]] [[Category:Grineer]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Slash Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Shotgun]] [[Category:Augmented Weapons]] [[uk:Дракґун]]

The '''Dex Furis''' is the [[Dex]] version of the {{Weapon|Afuris}}, with higher [[critical chance]] and [[status chance]], fire rate, and magazine and max ammo size, at some expense to damage. It was released in celebration of [[WARFRAME]]'s 1<sup>st</sup> [[Anniversary]].

==Characteristics==
*This weapon primarily deals {{D|Puncture}} damage.

{{Advantages|}}
{{Disadvantages|}}

{{WeaponComparison|Afuris}}
{{WeaponComparison|Afuris Prime|header=n}}

==Acquisition==
The Dex Furis was released in commemoration of [[WARFRAME]]'s 1<sup>st</sup> Year [[Anniversary]]. It is obtainable through yearly anniversaries in March via [[Alert]]s, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed [[Orokin Catalyst]].

==Notes==
*This weapon cannot use the {{M|Winds of Purity}} {{Weapon|Furis}} augment. Only the single Furis can use this augment.
*The Dex Furis is considered a variant of the {{Weapon|Afuris}}, and thus can use [[Riven Mods]] for said weapon.

==Tips==
*Players can make use of its high status chance by adding dual stat mods to increase its effectiveness against armor via modding for {{D|Corrosive}} to allow for corrosive procs to reduce enemy armor.
*Upgrading its Status Chance to 100% with five of the six mods listed above, then equipping {{M|Barrel Diffusion}}, {{M|Lethal Torrent}} and {{M|Gunslinger}} will result in 130 status effects per second being inflicted on a target.
*Players can take advantage of its {{Pol|Naramon}} polarity early on by using {{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}} (or {{M|Trick Mag}}, lacking the former) as soon as possible and save on [[Squad Ammo Restore]]s when using the Dex Furis. {{M|Pistol Scavenger}} may also be of use.

==Trivia==
*Interestingly, the Dex Furis uses the naming scheme of the single variant rather than the *A*furis akimbo variant.
*The Dex Furis is the first item to be given the [[Dex]] prefix.
*During the Tenno Live 2015 panel at PAX East, the developers present confirmed that "Dex" denotes WARFRAME anniversary gifts from the Lotus.
*Unlike Vandal and Wraith variants, the Dex Furis use a unique weapon model when compared to the regular Furis/Afuris.
*The Dex Furis was first awarded to every Tenno who logged in between {{ver|12.6}} release March 26 and April 2, 2014, in honor of the first anniversary of WARFRAME on PC. It was released again in {{ver|16.1.2}} between March 25 and April 1, 2015, along with the {{Weapon|Dex Dakra}}. They were re-released once again between March 22 and March 29, 2016, alongside the Dex Dakra and {{Weapon|Dex Sybaris}}. All three were available again from March 24, 2017 through March 27, 2017.
*The models are non-static; two hemispheres on both sides of the weapons rotates slowly. They rotate faster when the weapons are fired, and gradually slow down afterward. The magazines are also ejected during reloading.
*The Dex Furis was released again for WARFRAME's Second Anniversary on March 25, 2015. Players who already had a Dex Furis from the previous year would receive a second set. Since the weapon cannot be traded or gifted, the weapon simply lingers in the inventory if the player already has a set from the first anniversary.
**Players can delete their spare to make use of the free weapon slot it came in.
*At the time of its release, the [[wikipedia:Muzzle flash|muzzle flash]] of the Dex Furis was purple and it could not be modified by any means. This was fixed in {{ver|14.5}}; the muzzle flash can now be modified via Energy color.
**Its muzzle flash consists of a mesh of [[Lotus]] sigils arranged to look as such.
*As of {{ver|18.6.2}}, the muzzle flash appears as the Lotus symbol.

The '''Dera Vandal''' is the [[Vandal]] variant of the {{Weapon|Dera}} assault rifle, with higher damage, critical damage, [[status chance]], and magazine size.

==Characteristics==

* This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage.

{{Advantages|name=Dera Vandal}}

{{Disadvantages|* Projectiles have travel time, making long range shots more difficult.|name=Dera Vandal}}

{{WeaponComparison|Dera}}

==Acquisition==
Blueprints and components are a potential [[Invasion]] reward. All components can be [[Trade System|traded]], although players must have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 7 to acquire the blueprint.

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*The projectiles may possibly obstruct view when firing if the energy color is a bright color such as yellow, blue, or green.
*Due to the projectiles firing from alternating barrels, this has a convergence effect where the bolts will meet at the point the crosshair is on. This will result in the bolts crossing in an 'X' if they miss their target.

== Incarnon Genesis ==
{{Transclude|Dera Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}}

{{Transclude|Dera Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}}

==Trivia==
*This weapon was originally introduced as a potential reward if [[Nef Anyo]] was the victor of the conflict during the [[Operation: Tubemen of Regor]] [[event]]. ==Acquisition==
The Dex Sybaris was released in commemoration of [[WARFRAME]]'s 3<sup>rd</sup> Year [[Anniversary]]. It is obtainable through yearly anniversaries in March via [[Alert]]s, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed [[Orokin Catalyst]].

==Incarnon Genesis==
{{Transclude|Sybaris Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}}

{{Transclude|Sybaris Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}}

==Trivia==
*The Dex Sybaris is the third [[Dex]] weapon released, after the {{Weapon|Dex Furis}} and the {{Weapon|Dex Dakra}}. It is also the first Dex primary weapon to be released.
*The Dex Sybaris has three energy dots near the trigger which indicates that the weapon was released on the third anniversary. The same can be seen for the other Dex weapons: {{Weapon|Dex Dakra}} has two dots, and {{Weapon|Dex Furis}} has one.
*Details on this weapon were leaked via the [[Warframe Companion]] mobile app.
*When firing the Dex Sybaris, the Lotus logo will appear as a muzzle flash, and its color can be customized via the Dex Sybaris's energy color.
*The Dex Sybaris is one of the very few guns in-game with a visible full-length bore.
*The Dex Sybaris was first released from March 22, 2016 to March 29, 2016 on PC, and from April 9, 2016 to April 15, 2016 for consoles. It was released again from March 24, 2017 to March 27, 2017.
